scenes.say: Tinha alguém dentro da sua casa. Comendo o seu último miojo. Dia cinco.
scenes.prompt: View from the half-open front door into a small Brazilian apartment lit by a single candle: the stick figure girl Bia from the reference sheet (long black ponytail, red bandana headband) sits at the kitchen table eating dry instant noodles straight from the packet, a black frying pan on the table next to her. She has not noticed us yet. Warm candle light, dark corners.

scenes.say: Você entra com o taco levantado... e leva uma frigideirada na cabeça.
scenes.prompt: Comedic cartoon action shot inside the candle-lit apartment: the stick figure girl Bia with the red bandana swings a black frying pan and hits the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat on the head with a big BONK; his hat flies off, cartoon stars and impact lines around his head, his pool cue drops, the caramel mutt dog with the red collar jumps back surprised. No text.
scenes.video_prompt: Animate this flat 2D cartoon illustration: the girl swings the frying pan and bonks the stick figure with the yellow bucket hat, his hat flies up into the air, cartoon stars spin around his head, he wobbles and falls backward, the dog jumps back. Snappy comedic cartoon timing. Keep the exact flat 2D cartoon style, bold outlines and colors. No morphing, no text.

scenes.say: Quando você acorda, uma garota de bandana vermelha tá sentada no seu sofá, com o Caramelo no colo.
scenes.prompt: Candle-lit Brazilian living room: the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat lies on the floor in the foreground, dizzy, waking up with small cartoon stars over his head and a bump on his head. In the background the stick figure girl Bia with the red bandana sits relaxed on the worn sofa with the caramel mutt dog in her lap, petting it; the dog looks happy.

scenes.say: Foi mal, ela diz. Achei que você era um deles. O nome dela é Bia.
scenes.prompt: Close-up portrait in warm candle light: the stick figure girl Bia from the reference sheet (long black ponytail, red bandana headband) gives an awkward apologetic smile, one hand scratching the back of her head, the other still holding the black frying pan. Dark apartment background.

scenes.say: Ela tá sozinha desde o dia um. Tem uma lanterna, três latas de sardinha... e um rádio de pilha.
scenes.prompt: Top-down view of a wooden kitchen table lit by a candle: neatly laid out are a flashlight, exactly three cans of sardines, and an old portable battery radio with an antenna. The hands of the stick figure girl Bia (thin black lines) arrange the items; the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat leans over the table looking at them.

scenes.say: Se você quer saber se dá pra confiar nela, segue o perfil: faltam vinte e cinco dias.
scenes.prompt: Cozy but tense moment in the candle-lit apartment: the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat (with a small bandage on his head) and the stick figure girl Bia with the red bandana sit on the sofa a little apart from each other, the caramel mutt dog with the red collar lying between them. He looks at her suspiciously, she looks away.

scenes.say: À noite, ela gira o botão do rádio. Só chiado. Até que...
scenes.prompt: Night in the dark apartment, only one candle: the stick figure girl Bia with the red bandana slowly turns the dial of the old portable radio, its small orange dial glowing; the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat leans in to listen. Little zig-zag static lines come out of the speaker.

scenes.say: Uma voz. Atenção, sobreviventes. Resgate no estádio, daqui a vinte e cinco dias. Repetindo: vinte e cinco dias.
scenes.prompt: Dramatic close-up of an old portable battery radio on a table at night, its glowing orange dial lit, sound waves radiating from the speaker. Behind it, slightly out of focus, the shocked faces of the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat and the stick figure girl Bia with the red bandana, eyes wide open.

scenes.say: Vinte e cinco dias. Você olha pro calendário. O resgate cai exatamente... no dia trinta.
scenes.prompt: A paper wall calendar of the month hanging on an apartment wall, lit by candle light: days 1 to 5 are crossed out with black X marks, and day 30 is circled several times in red marker with the word 'RESGATE' handwritten next to it. A stick figure hand holds the red marker. Dramatic.
